prompts.title: Recent form: grouped outcomes
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 compositing for a 6-10 second transcript-led insert. Reserve the lower quarter for permanent yellow subtitles over charcoal #101412, with a subtle dark scrim so captions stay legible. Editorial presentation: kinetic typography built from Spanish words 'FORMA RECIENTE', 'VICTORIA', 'EMPATE', 'DERROTA' in warm white #edf0e6 and lime #c5ed74, arranged as three rhythmic lanes that punch in on the spoken beats. Kazajistán and Islas Feroe appear as Spanish team labels in slate #8ca6bf on opposite sides of the frame; their lane markers pulse in time with narration. No axes, no counts, no invented events. Main emphasis is the rhythmic contrast between the two team names; camera does a slow push-in from three-quarter height to centre, then a small parallax drift. Entry: letters slide from the lower quarter upward with a hard cut on the first spoken word. Transition: a lime wipe sweeps upward to reveal the statistical variant, then a soft match cut returns to editorial during the team-name callout. Exit: typography compresses into a single line and fades to charcoal. Statistical presentation: grouped count bars for wins, draws and losses per team, using a shared zero baseline and the same unit partidos. Bars are charcoal #101412 with warm white outlines; wins use lime #c5ed74, draws use slate #8ca6bf, losses use warm white #edf0e6. Kazajistán group and Islas Feroe group sit side by side, each with Spanish labels 'Kazajistán · victorias' {{home.wins}}, 'Kazajistán · empates' {{home.draws}}, 'Kazajistán · derrotas' {{home.losses}}, 'Islas Feroe · victorias' {{away.wins}}, 'Islas Feroe · empates' {{away.draws}}, 'Islas Feroe · derrotas' {{away.losses}}. Sample/source annotation sits beneath each group: sample n = {{home.n}} for Kazajistán and sample n = {{away.n}} for Islas Feroe, with source string from catalog and provider Bzzoiro. If samples are unequal, add a Spanish note 'muestras distintas' beside the larger group. Entry animation: zero baseline draws first, then bars grow vertically in staggered order. Main comparison: outcome distribution across both teams. Emphasis: the tallest bar gets a lime edge glow and a short camera push; secondary bars remain slate. Transition: chart slides half width left as editorial lanes reappear. Exit: axis labels collapse into a compact source/sample stamp.

prompts.title: Goals for and against: paired bars
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 animation for 6-10 seconds, lower quarter reserved for permanent yellow subtitles over charcoal #101412. Editorial presentation: illustrative football pitch in perspective, charcoal turf with warm white lines, lime #c5ed74 ball path and slate #8ca6bf player silhouettes. Spanish headings 'GOLES' and team names 'Kazajistán', 'Islas Feroe' animate as large warm white type. Ball travels along a curved path from one half to the other on the narration beat, then rebounds; this is symbolic movement, not a match event. No axes, no counts, no sample claims. Emphasis on the ball's lime trail and the pitch's vanishing point. Camera tilts down from high angle to pitch level, then drifts laterally. Entry: pitch lines draw outward from centre circle. Transition: ball exits frame and its trail becomes the baseline of the statistical chart. Exit: pitch fades to charcoal while Spanish 'GOLES' remains. Statistical presentation: paired horizontal bars for both teams, comparing goles a favor and goles recibidos. Shared scale in unit goles, common zero baseline. Kazajistán pair: 'Kazajistán · goles a favor' {{home.gf}} in lime and 'Kazajistán · goles recibidos' {{home.ga}} in slate. Islas Feroe pair: 'Islas Feroe · goles a favor' {{away.gf}} in lime and 'Islas Feroe · goles recibidos' {{away.ga}} in slate. Each bar carries a direct value label resolved by renderer; unit label 'goles' is fixed at axis end. Sample/source annotation under each team: sample n = {{home.n}} for Kazajistán and sample n = {{away.n}} for Islas Feroe, with source string from catalog and provider Bzzoiro. Entry animation: baseline sweeps across, then paired bars extend simultaneously per team. Main comparison: attacking output versus defensive concession for both teams. Emphasis: the larger gap within each pair gets a warm white bracket and a slight camera push. Transition: vertical lime line wipes from pitch to chart and back. Exit: bars retract to zero baseline, leaving source/sample stamp and Spanish 'GOLES'.

prompts.title: Clean sheets: counts and samples
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 motion insert, 6-10 seconds. Lower quarter reserved for permanent yellow subtitles over charcoal #101412. Editorial presentation: defensive energy as a stylised shield. A large shield outline in warm white #edf0e6 and lime #c5ed74 pulses at centre; inside, Spanish heading 'ARCOS EN CERO' and Spanish team labels 'Kazajistán' and 'Islas Feroe' orbit as slate #8ca6bf tags. Motion is rhythmic and protective, with short impact ripples on beat. No axes, no counts, no invented saves or match events. Main focal point is the shield edge; camera slowly rotates around the shield, then settles front-on. Entry: shield ribs draw sequentially from top to bottom. Transition: shield splits into two halves that become the statistical count bars. Exit: shield closes and fades to charcoal while Spanish 'DEFENSA' stays briefly. Statistical presentation: two horizontal count bars comparing clean sheet counts, not rates. Shared zero baseline and same unit partidos. Bar for Kazajistán uses lime #c5ed74 and Spanish label 'Kazajistán · arcos en cero' {{home.clean}}; bar for Islas Feroe uses slate #8ca6bf and Spanish label 'Islas Feroe · arcos en cero' {{away.clean}}. Direct value labels resolved by renderer, unit 'partidos' fixed at axis end. Sample/source annotation attached to each bar: sample n = {{home.n}} for Kazajistán and sample n = {{away.n}} for Islas Feroe, with source string from catalog and provider Bzzoiro. Entry animation: baseline draws, then both bars extend; sample chips slide in afterward. Main comparison: clean sheet counts under each recent sample. Emphasis: the higher count receives a lime outline and a short camera push; the lower count remains slate with no negative colour. Transition: a horizontal warm white wipe moves from shield to chart. Exit: bars collapse into a single dot beside the source/sample stamp, then fade.

prompts.title: Head-to-head: historical duel
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 duel sequence, 6-10 seconds, lower quarter reserved for permanent yellow subtitles over charcoal #101412. Editorial presentation: both teams as a visual duel. Kazajistán and Islas Feroe appear as Spanish team labels in large warm white #edf0e6 and slate #8ca6bf on opposite sides of a central lime #c5ed74 vertical line. Abstract crests or jersey blocks move toward each other in a tug-of-war rhythm, then hold at centre. Spanish heading 'HISTORIAL' and 'CRUCES PREVIOS' flash on beat. No axes, no counts, no invented goals or predictions. Main emphasis is the central tension line; camera pushes in slowly along the line, then pulls back. Entry: two team blocks slide from left and right. Transition: the central line expands into the statistical chart baseline. Exit: blocks retreat and fade to charcoal. Statistical presentation: a single stacked horizontal bar representing historical head-to-head outcomes, with segments for 'Kazajistán · victorias en cruces' {{h2h.homeWins}}, 'Empates en cruces' {{h2h.draws}} and 'Islas Feroe · victorias en cruces' {{h2h.awayWins}}. Shared scale in unit partidos, zero baseline, total sample annotation 'Cruces previos' {{h2h.total}} with source string from catalog and provider Bzzoiro. Colour segments: Kazajistán wins lime #c5ed74, draws warm white #edf0e6, Islas Feroe wins slate #8ca6bf. Direct value labels resolved by renderer; Spanish legend labels remain fixed. Entry animation: baseline draws, then segments grow left to right in historical order. Main comparison: win/draw counts within the available historical sample. Emphasis: the draw segment gets a brief warm white pulse because it is the shared middle; no segment is labelled as a forecast. Historical data is not a forecast, and a Spanish note 'Historial, no pronóstico' stays beside the source/sample stamp. Transition: stacked bar splits into two team blocks for the duel exit. Exit: total sample label and source stamp remain as the composition fades.

prompts.title: Synthesis: no wins against no losses
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 narrative synthesis, 6-10 seconds, lower quarter reserved for permanent yellow subtitles over charcoal #101412. Editorial presentation: two team reveals. Start with Spanish heading 'SEÑALES RECIENTES' in warm white #edf0e6. Kazajistán appears first as a lime #c5ed74 outline block with Spanish label; Islas Feroe appears second as a slate #8ca6bf outline block. They slide in from opposite edges, pause, then rotate slightly toward each other. Narrative emphasis lands on the spoken tension: one side has no victories in its sample, the other has no defeats in its sample. No axes, no counts, no invented match events. Camera does a slow parallax push between the two blocks, then settles centre. Entry: team blocks scale up with a soft blur. Transition: both blocks collapse into the statistical bars. Exit: blocks merge into a single source/sample stamp and fade. Statistical presentation: paired horizontal count bars showing the grounded tension between 'Kazajistán · victorias' {{home.wins}} and 'Islas Feroe · derrotas' {{away.losses}}, with context bars for 'Kazajistán · empates' {{home.draws}} and 'Islas Feroe · empates' {{away.draws}}. Same unit partidos, shared zero baseline, common scale across all bars. Colours: Kazajistán bars lime #c5ed74, Islas Feroe bars slate #8ca6bf, context bars at lower opacity but still legible. Direct value labels resolved by renderer; Spanish labels fixed. Sample/source annotation under each team: sample n = {{home.n}} for Kazajistán and sample n = {{away.n}} for Islas Feroe, with source string from catalog and provider Bzzoiro. Entry animation: baseline draws, then the two tension bars grow first, context bars second. Main comparison: absence of wins against absence of losses in the recent samples. Emphasis: the two tension bars receive a short lime edge trace and a camera push; no predictive language appears. Transition: warm white wipe moves from narrative blocks to bars and back. Exit: bars retract, narrative blocks dissolve, source/sample stamp holds for the final beat.
